source.name: Calcio e Finanza, 'I ricavi da sponsor di maglia in Serie A: il Napoli vola al quinto posto, Milan in vetta'
source.quote: 10 – Cagliari – Regione Sardegna e Doppio Malto: 3,6 milioni di euro a stagione

note: Press estimate for the combined front-of-shirt deal ('main sponsor' ranking for 2026/27). The two front brands are reported together, so the value is booked on one deal with both named in orgName. Start date not reported. Calcio Casteddu (2026-03-11) gives the same EUR 3.6m a season and calls Cagliari ninth in Serie A.
